name: A basket mint by an account holding NO nets against it
notes: Found by fuzz.py seed 3: charging 100 per basket when the new YES closes existing NO breaks conservation.
Prelude: account 1 bids 2 of outcome 2001 at 40c; account 2 sells into it from flat, so account 2 holds 2 NO (sellerCash 80 - 200 = -120, balance 9880).
Before the mint, account 2's NO pays 200 in states 1 and 2. Collateral 200; every state's payouts total 200.
Mint 2 baskets: K = min(2, 2) + 0 + 0 = 2 NO closed on 2001. Positions become 0, 2, 2. Cash -100 * (2 - 2) = 0, collateral unchanged.
Account 2's payout is still 200 in states 1 and 2, so nothing was bought and nothing is charged. Its balance is unchanged, so no SleeveChanged.
Redeeming 2 needs 2 unlocked YES in every book; 2001 now holds 0, so INSUFFICIENT_POSITION.
